title: Dashcam Captures Drunk Passenger Falling Off Bridge Into Creek
description:
** (Disclaimer: This video content is intended for educational and informational purposes only) **
A deputy in Tennessee captured video of a drunk man falling head-first off a bridge into a creek. As the deputy's patrol car approaches the stopped vehicle, the passenger steps out of the truck and falls into the creek. It didn't take long for the deputy to figure out the men had been drinking.

Both men were arrested. The driver was charged with driving under the influence. The passenger is charged with public intoxication.
